name: Xerneas's Major Gift - Bounty of Life
effect_text: The Target is cured of all Injuries and Status Effects.

name: Xerneas's Major Gift - Fairy Aura
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Major Gift- Bounty of Life
effect_text: You gain the Fairy Aura Ability.

name: Xerneas's Minor Gift - Rejuvenating Aura
effect_text: When taking an Extended Rest, you and all Trainers and Pokémon in the vicinity are treated as if you spent the night at Poke Center, regardless of where you are.

name: Xerneas's Pact Gift - Geomancy
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: All Xerneas Major Gifts and Shared
effect_text: You learn the Move Geomancy.

name: Yveltal's Major Gift - Dark Aura
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Major Gift - Touch of the Flayed One
effect_text: You gain the Dark Aura Ability.

name: Yveltal's Major Gift - Touch of the Flayed One
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Minor Gift - Touch of Death
effect_text: You inflict an additional Injury.

name: Yveltal's Minor Gift - Death Dealer
effect_text: Injuries you inflict will not heal at the normal rate and require extensive medical treatment, such as staying at a Poke Center, to heal. Instead of recovering at the normal rate of three Injuries per day while at such a facility, they heal at a rate of one injury a day.

name: Yveltal's Pact Gift - Oblivion Wing
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: All Yveltal Major Gifts and Shared
effect_text: You learn the Move Oblivion Wing.

name: Zapdos's Major Gift - Lightningrod
effect_text: You gain the Lightningrod Ability.

name: Zekrom's Major Gift - Black Yin
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Minor Gift - Hero of Ideals
effect_text: All allies within 5 meters may choose to decrease their movement speeds by 1 and raise their evasion by 2 for the next three rounds.

name: Zekrom's Major Gift - Teravolt
effect_text: You gain the Teravolt Ability.

name: Zekrom's Minor Gift - Hero of Ideals
effect_text: You get a +3 bonus on Intuition Checks to discern someone's beliefs and ideals.

name: Zekrom's Pact Gift - Bolt Strike
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: All Zekrom and Shared Tao Trio Major
effect_text: You learn the Move Bolt Strike.

name: In My Name
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Messiah, GM Permission | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Completed a task on behalf of your Patron, GM Permission | Rank 3 Prerequisites: A Major Gift, GM Permission | Rank 4 Prerequisites: A Pact Gift, GM Permission
effect_text: You acquire a Blessing marked with the In My Name Rank you are gaining or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.

name: Messiah
effect_text: Your Connection with one of your Patrons has reached such a point that even you are capable of perform- ing the miracles they are renowned and worshiped for. Expending a use of Messiah allows you to perform such a miracle. For example, in a Region where Shaymin is known to restore withered forests to their former glory, a Touched who is a Messiah of Shaymin might be able to cause a forest to start to rapidly recover from the aftermath of a wildfire. Such acts are usually, but not always, noticeably supernatural and divine.

name: Sign Mastery
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Signer, GM Permission | Rank 2 Prerequisites: A Major Gift, GM Permission | Rank 3 Prerequisites: All your Patron's Major Gifts, GM Permission | Rank 4 Prerequisites: A Pact Gift, GM Permission
effect_text: You acquire two Blessings in the form of Signs, marked with the Sign Mastery Rank you are gaining or lower. You must additionally meet any Prerequisites of the Blessing.

name: Signer
effect_text: Choose a Rank 1 Blessing. You gain this Blessing in the form of a Sign. Signs store the energy of the Divine, and may be activated as a Swift Action. Signs can be used once per Scene, and cost 1 AP to activate.

name: Major Gift
effect_text: You gain one of your Patron's Major Gifts. This Major Gift may be of your GM's choosing. This feat is able to be taken multiple times based on your GM's dis- cretion.

name: Pact Gift
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: All of your Patron's Major Gifts, GM Per-
effect_text: You gain your Patron's Pact Gift. Lower Panthe- on Legendaries do not have Pact Gifts.

name: Soulbound
effect_text: Whenever your Patron feels strong emotions (positive or negative) or pain, those sensations will be shared with you, no matter the distance between you. You may take Soulbound multiple times, each time for a different instance of Touched.

name: Touched
effect_text: You have been blessed by a Legendary and gain their Minor Gift. This Legendary is considered one of your Patrons. You may take Touched multiple times, each time for a different Patron.

name: Gift of Power
effect_text: You gift your target with a Blessing of your own. Whether this makes them Touched, a Signer, or Brand- ed is at your digression. The actual Blessings may not need be the one listed here for your Legendary Form, but ones of your own creation at your GM's discretion.

name: Shared Strengths
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Pokemon Form Level 20 | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Pokemon Form Level 35 | Rank 3 Prerequisites: True Power, Pokemon Form

name: True Power
effect_text: You gain one of the Domains and its corre- sponding Legendary Aura associated with your Leg- endary Form. This Feature may be taken multiple times, but with the second time at Pokemon Form Level 60, and the third at Pokemon Form level 75.

name: Usurper
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: You have slain a God and through occult ritual or technology have absorbed its essence.
effect_text: Your human form is now considered your Avatar, and you gain a second set of stats for your Pokémon form. This form is that of the Legendary you usurped, starts at level 1 with the nature and abilities of your choice, and may gain experience as if it were a Pokémon you owned. Switching between your human form and this one takes a Standard Action. Usurpers cannot receive Gifts or Blessings from other Legendaries, as they are divinity themselves now. Any Touched, Branded, Messiah, and Signer Edges and Features you possessed up until this point are refunded. The Patron Stats for this Feature and all other Usurper Features matches the stats of the Legendary you Usurped.

name: Ace Conjurer
effect_text: Pode usar occult education pra comandar Unowns, Prime Unown, Eudomown and the temporary pokemons. Especial: You can have +1 hidden power.

name: Conjurer
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Rune Master, Adept Occult Education, Novice Pokemon Education
effect_text: You roll a test of Pokemon Education, DC - 15, channeling the energy of Unowns to create a temporary pokemon. The temporary pokemon has its signature and natural moves. If it has any available move slot, you may choose from its level move list. If the temporary pokemon faint, the Unown, Prime Unown or Eudomown which the energy is channeling faints too. This conjuration lasts for the scene, until the pokemon faints or the pokemon is switched.

name: Critical Buff
effect_text: The damage receives +3d8 damage.

name: Enhancer
prerequisites_text: Prerequisite: Novice Occult Education or Novice Focus
effect_text: If the move is "melee 1 target" it gains the "pass" tag. If the move is "Ranged 1, Xm" gains the "Blast 2" tag.

name: Grimoire
effect_text: You create a book which memorizes a pokemon. When you have a pokemon in it, you may conjure it without the test.

name: Hidden Armor
effect_text: You can conjure a cloth or an armor.

name: Hidden Coat
effect_text: You or your pokemon with hidden power receive a "coat" which gives you 20 temporary "Hit Points". "Hidden Coat" may only be used once per scene per target.

name: Hidden Weapon
effect_text: You can conjure a weapon. It has the propriety of an arcane weapon with the adept move, "hidden power" and the Master move, "concealed power".

name: Legendary Conjure
effect_text: Your unowns can conjure a Legendary pokemon.

name: Power Enhance
effect_text: You learn the move "Concealed Power"

name: Resolve Boost
effect_text: After the damage resolves, if not fainted, recovery 20 HP points.

name: Secret Garden
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisite: Enhancer | Rank 2 Prerequisite: Secret Garden Rank 1 | Rank 3 Prerequisite: Secret Garden Rank 2 | Rank 4 Prerequisite: Secret Garden Rank 3
effect_text: each Rank you gain two "Enhancer" Buffs.

name: Type Mastery
effect_text: Instead of using the normal cost for "hidden weapon" and "hidden armor" you use this feature cost. Your weapon and armor match the type and you gain one ability for each.

name: Agility Training
effect_text: The target becomes Agile until the end of the effect duration. Agile Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Movement Capabilities and +4 to Initiative.

name: Blur
effect_text: Attacks and Moves targeting you that don't require an Accuracy Check now require one, as though they had Accuracy Check of 2. You may only apply half of your Evasion to these Attacks and Moves.

name: Brace for Impact
effect_text: While this Feature is Bound, once a round, when the target uses a self-targeting Status Move, they may gain 5 Damage Reduction until the end of their next turn. They may also activate this effect as a Standard Action.

name: Brutal Training
effect_text: The target becomes Brutal until the end of the effect duration. Brutal Pokémon increase the Critical- Hit and Effect Range of all attacks by +1.

name: Capricious Whirl
effect_text: While this Feature is Bound, the target has a +3 bonus to its Evasion but deals 5 less damage with all damaging attacks.

name: Command Versatility
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Adept Command, Guile, or Pokémon
effect_text: Your Pokémon may give up use of a Scene or Daily Move to regain use of a Scene or Daily Move which it has already used. Your Pokémon may give up use of a Daily Move to regain use of a Scene Move, but not vice-versa. You may use Command Versatility only once per Scene per Pokémon.

name: Commander's Voice
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Two Features with the [Orders] tag
effect_text: You may give two different [Orders] as a single Standard Action, or you may give one set of [Orders] as a Swift Action.

name: Dazzling Dervish
effect_text: Until the end of their next turn, the target adds their non-stat Evasion to their Movement Capabilities and whenever they attack a foe or Shift through a square occupied by a foe, that foe suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls until the end of their next turn. This effect may only affect a foe once per round.

name: Defender
effect_text: Using the Intercept Maneuvers requires only a Shift Action Interrupt.

name: Dive
effect_text: You may immediately Shift 1 Meter, and then become Tripped. This Feature cannot be used if you are Stuck, Grappled, or otherwise impaired from Shifting. This Feature causes you to dodge Ranged attacks aimed at you, and may let you avoid Cones, Bursts, Blasts, or Lines if the shift removes you from the area of effect.

name: Fighter's Versatility
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Learned two Scene or Daily Moves.
effect_text: You may give up use of a Scene or Daily Move to regain use of a Scene or Daily Move which you have already used. You may give up use of a Daily Move to regain use of a Scene Move, but not vice-versa.

name: First Aid Expertise
effect_text: The target may remove one Injury, has all Hit Points restored, and is cured of all Status Afflictions. You may use First Aid Expertise only once per day per target. First Aid Expertise requires access to a First Aid Kit.

name: Focused Command
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Master Command, one of Focus, Guile,
activation_text: Intimidate, or Pokémon Education at Expert At-Will - Standard Action + Swift Action
effect_text: You may have a second Pokémon take a turn this round, but both Pokémon can only take At-Will actions that round. Additionally, both Pokémon receive a -5 Penalty on all Damage Rolls. You may pay 1 AP at the beginning of the round to lift the Frequency Restriction OR the Damage Penalty for the remainder of the round, or pay 2 AP to lift both.

name: Focused Training
effect_text: The target becomes Focused until the end of the effect duration. Focused Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Accuracy Rolls and +2 to Skill Checks.

name: Guardian Orders
effect_text: You gain the Brace for Impact and Sentinel Stance Orders.

name: Inspired Training
effect_text: The target becomes Inspired until the end of the effect duration. Inspired Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Evasion and +2 to Save Checks.

name: Let Me Help You With That
effect_text: The ally may re-roll the Skill Check with a Bonus equal to your Skill Rank.

name: Long Shot
effect_text: The target's damaging ranged attacks have their range doubled until the end of their next turn, and deal X additional damage. X is equal to the distance in meters that the attack traveled. Long Shot does not increase the size of area of effect attacks. If attacks altered by Long Shot are Critical Hits, add the value of the Damage Dice Roll an additional time to the total damage.

name: Marksman Orders
effect_text: You gain the Trick Shot and Long Shot Orders.

name: Multi-Tasking
effect_text: You may take two Standard Actions instead of one this turn, but both actions must have an At-Will Frequency.

name: Perfect Aim
effect_text: The next damaging attack the target performs before the end of your next turn automatically hits and ignores Defensive Abilities but deals damage as if it were resisted one step further than normal. You may still roll to trigger any Effect Ranges or Critical Hits. All targets of the attack may not activate any Blessings in response, and the attack may not be Intercepted or avoided in any way (ex: with Dodge, Shield Moves, etc).

name: Pinpoint Strike
effect_text: Increase the Accuracy and Effect Range of the target's damaging attacks by +2. These attacks deal 5 less damage, before applying weakness and resistance.

name: Poké Ball Crafter
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Basic Balls, Poké Ball Repair, Expert
effect_text: You may craft Dusk, Dive, Heal, Luxury, Net, Nest, Quick, Repeat, or Timer Balls for $700. Requires access to a Poké Ball Tool Box.

name: PokéManiac
effect_text: Make a Pokemon Education Check with a DC of 10. If you succeed, you determine the target's Level, Types, Nature, and Abilities.

name: Precision Orders
effect_text: You gain the Pinpoint Strike and Perfect Aim Orders.

name: Press
effect_text: You hit your Pokémon, and they lose 1/6th of their Max Hit Points and are cured of Sleep. Raise any two of their Stats by +1 CS each, and you may add half of your Intimidate Rank to any Skill Checks made this round to make this Pokémon obey orders. Using Press on a Pokémon may make them dislike you.

name: Psionic Sight
effect_text: You are able to visibly see any Psychic Residue left on Humans or Pokémon due to the effects of Psionic abilities. Each Human or Pokémon leaves distinct Psychic Residue on their targets; you are easily able to distinguish which targets have been affected by the same Psionic, though to identify that Psionic you need to have a way of knowing their signature (such as simply seeing them do it, and seeing the resulting signature).

name: Quick Switch
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Novice Acrobatics or Novice Guile
effect_text: You may return and send out a Pokémon as a Free Action. You may perform this Feature on your turn without a Trigger. Pokémon sent out by Quick Switch cannot trigger another trainer's Quick Switch. When you swap Pokémon using Quick Switch, you do not lose a Pokémon turn.

name: Ravager Orders
effect_text: You gain the Reckless Advance and Strike Again! Orders.

name: Reckless Advance
effect_text: While this Feature is Bound, increase the damage rolls of the target's damaging melee attacks by +8, and these attacks Trip targets on Accuracy Rolls of 18+. When the target of Reckless Advance hits with a damaging melee attack, they become Vulnerable for one full round.

name: Sentinel Stance
effect_text: Until the end of your next turn, the target may attempt to Intercept attacks for allies as a Shift Action. If they do so, they gain 10 Damage Reduction against the attack. If the target is also under the effect of Brace for Impact, they may gain 5 Damage Reduction from it as if they had used a self-targeting Status Move.

name: Signature Move
effect_text: Choose a Move you know. Increase the Move's Frequency one step, as if you had used a PP Up. This choice cannot be changed once made. This Feature may not select Moves known through temporary means, nor can these Moves be used to qualify for this Feature.

name: Skill Monkey
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Three Skills at Adept Rank or higher
effect_text: You may re-roll the triggering Skill Check with a +2 Bonus, taking the new result. This Feature may be used to re-roll a specific roll only once.

name: Species Savant
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: 3 different individual Pokémon of the
effect_text: When you take Species Savant, choose a single Evolutionary Family. Your Pokémon of your Chosen Evolutionary Family have each of their Base Stats increased by +1.

name: Strike Again!
effect_text: The target may immediately take an additional Standard Action to use an At-Will attack.

name: Trick Shot
effect_text: While this Feature is Bound, decrease the Accu- racy Roll of the target's damaging ranged attacks by -2. The Critical Hit range of those attacks is increased by +3. This Feature does not affect Moves without an AC value.

name: Trickster Orders
effect_text: You gain the Capricious Whirl and Dazzling Dervish Orders.

name: Tutoring
activation_text: Effect) One Time Use x 3 - Extended Action
effect_text: When activating this Feature, select a Move known either by yourself or by 3 Pokémon you own. This Move is Mastered. As an Extended Action, you may have Pokémon spend 2 Tutor Points to learn a Move you have Mastered. Pokémon targeted this way can only learn Moves that they could learn by Level Up, TM, Egg Move, or Move Tutor. You may take Tutoring multiple times, each time gaining 3 uses of the Feature.

name: Type Expertise
activation_text: All Ranks Prerequisites: Level 9, 3 Moves of the Chosen Type in your Move List Static
effect_text: Each Rank, choose a Type of which you know at least 3 Moves. You gain STAB for the chosen Type. STAB is never applied to Struggle Attacks.

name: Walk It Off
effect_text: Remove one Injury from yourself and regain 1/4th of your maximum Hit Points. This Injury removal doesn't count against the natural healing limit on Injuries each day.

name: Ace Trainer
effect_text: For each Pokémon that has been trained during this time, choose a Stat besides HP; that Stat becomes Trained until an Extended Rest is taken. The default State of Trained Stats is +1 Combat Stages instead of 0. A Pokémon may have only one Trained Stat at a time.

name: Champ in the Making
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: 4 Ace Trainer Features, Master Command
effect_text: Choose two Trained Stats for each Pokémon instead of one. A Pokémon may only have two Trained Stats this way.

name: Critical Moment
effect_text: The bonuses from your Pokemon's [Training] are tripled until the end of your next turn.

name: Elite Trainer
effect_text: Choose Agility Training, Brutal Training, Focused Training, or Inspired Training. You gain the chosen Feature, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. When training, you may apply up to two different [Training] Features on each of your Pokémon. If you already have all of these Features, instead pick another Feature for which you qualify.

name: Perseverance
effect_text: The target instead does not gain an Injury. Perseverance may activate only once per Scene per target.

name: Signature Technique
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points. Choose one Move on the Target's Move List. That Move becomes the target's Signature Technique, and you may apply one of the modifications on the next page to the Move. The Move being modified must fit the category of the modification, and you must have the associated Training Feature to apply a modification. A Pokémon may only have one Signature Technique at a time. If you choose to teach a Pokémon a different Signature Technique, the old one is lost, and 1 Tutor Point is refunded. 1 Tutor Point is also refunded if the Pokémon ever forgets a Signature Technique Move.

name: Top Percentage
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains an extra Tutor Point. Top Percentage may be used on a single Pokémon a maximum of 4 times. Once a Pokémon has gained 4 Tutor Points in this way, increase each of that Pokémon's Base Stats by +1.

name: Adrenaline Rush
effect_text: You gain +1 Combat Stage in each of your Trained Stats, are cured of up to two Status Afflictions, and gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. Adrenaline Rush may be used only once per Scene

name: Athlete
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Novice Athletics, One of Athletic Prowess, Mounted Prowess, Power Boost, Stamina, or Swimmer
effect_text: After an hour of exercise, an Athlete may choose two different Stats besides HP; both of those stats become Trained Stats. The default State of Trained Stats is +1 Combat Stages instead of 0. An Athlete may have two Trained Stats at a time.

name: Athletic Moves
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Athlete | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Athlete, Expert Athletics | Rank 3 Prerequisites: Athlete, Master Athletics
effect_text: You learn two Athlete Moves marked with the Rank of this Feature you are taking or lower.

name: Coaching
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains a bonus based on the type of Combat maneuver they are making. This Feature may be triggered once per Scene per Pokémon.

name: Training Regime
effect_text: You gain additional static bonuses based on your Trained Stats.

name: Ambient Aura
effect_text: You gain an Aura Blessing that can be spent any time as a Free Action Interrupt. When you spend an Aura Blessing, you choose one of the effects below. You may only have one Aura Blessing at a time, and you must have the Aura Pulse Capability to use Ambient Aura.

name: Aura Guardian
effect_text: Choose two of Detect, Vacuum Wave, or Force Palm. You learn the chosen Moves.

name: Aura Mastery
effect_text: Choose two of Aura Sphere, Focus Blast, Drain Punch, or Focus Punch. You learn the chosen Moves.

name: Aura Reader
effect_text: You gain the Aura Reader Capability for the rest of the scene. If your Intuition is Adept Rank or higher, you also gain the Aura Pulse Capability.

name: Sword of Body and Soul
effect_text: You may have the triggering Move deal damage as if it was your choice of Physical or Special Classes. Regardless, add both your Attack and Special Attack Stats to the Damage Roll, and this attack ignores Damage Reduction. This does not stack with Twisted Power.

name: The Power of Aura
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Aura Guardian | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Aura Guardian, Expert Intuition
effect_text: Each Rank, choose Scrappy or Aura Storm. You gain the Chosen Ability.

name: Advanced Capture Techniques
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Capture Specialist | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Capture Specialist, any 2 Skills at | Rank 3 Prerequisites: Capture Specialist, any 2 Skills at | Rank 4 Prerequisites: Capture Specialist, any 3 Skills at
activation_text: Adept Rank Expert Rank Expert Rank Static
effect_text: At each Rank, you gain two Capture Techniques of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique. You may qualify for Advanced Capture Techniques' prerequisites with the Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills only.

name: Capture Specialist
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, or Survival at Novice; Guile, or Perception at Novice
effect_text: You gain two Capture Techniques of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique.

name: Catch Combo
activation_text: Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills at Expert Rank Daily - Free Action
effect_text: You may immediately throw a Poké Ball against the triggering Wild Pokémon, and it may be Captured even though it is knocked out. Calculate Capture Rate as if the target had 1 HP. If the Capture Attempt fails, the Pokémon is knocked out as normal.

name: False Strike
activation_text: Survival, Guile, or Perception at Expert Rank Scene x2 - Free Action
effect_text: The Wild Pokémon is instead lowered to 1 Hit Point.

name: Gotta Catch ‘Em All
effect_text: You may switch the rolled digits on your 1d100 roll. For example, if you roll a 91, that can be switched to a 19. This does not turn a roll of 1 into a "Natural" roll of 100.

name: Relentless Pursuit
activation_text: Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills at Expert Rank 2 AP - Free Action, Interrupt
effect_text: Before the target moves from its starting location, one of your Pokémon on the field may immediately Shift and use a Struggle Attack as an Interrupt. If this attack hits, the target is Tripped.

name: Battle Synchronization
effect_text: For one full round, whenever a Channeled Pokémon successfully hits a foe, all Channeled Pokémon gain +1 Accuracy and +1 Evasion against that foe for the duration of this Feature.

name: Channeler
effect_text: You Channel the target Pokémon. If you attempt to Channel a Hostile Pokémon, you must make an Intuition Check with a DC of 15 to Channel the target. You may stop Channeling a Pokémon as a Free Action at any time. You may Channel a number of Pokémon at a time up to your Intuition Rank. If a Channeled Pokémon goes further than 20 meters from you, they stop being Channeled.

name: Pain Dampening
effect_text: Choose any number of Channeled Pokémon, which must include the triggering Pokémon. Instead of resolving the attack normally, divide the damage from the attack by the number of chosen Pokémon. Each chosen Pokémon then loses that many Hit Points. For each chosen Pokémon that Resists or is Immune to the Type of the triggering attack, subtract your Intuition Rank from the damage of the attack before all calculations.

name: Shared Senses
effect_text: You Imprint the target for the duration of this Feature. You receive all sensory information being sensed by Imprinted Pokémon, and Imprinted Pokémon are not subject to the distance limit on Channeling. If you have Imprinted more than one Pokémon, you may only concentrate on the senses of one Pokémon at a time, and only choose one such Pokémon per round. If you stop Channeling a Pokémon, they are no longer Imprinted as well.

name: Soothing Connection
effect_text: Distribute 5 points in any way among Pokémon you are Channeling. For each point you assign to a Channeled Pokémon, they gain a Tick of Hit Points.

name: Spirit Boost
effect_text: When you use Spirit Boost, choose a Channeled Pokémon. You may choose the target of Spirit Boost if you wish. While Spirit Boost is Bound, the target has one of the following effects, depending on the highest Combat Stat of the chosen Pokémon. (In the event of a tie, you choose which Stat to use)

name: Cheer Brigade
effect_text: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the Friend Guard Ability.

name: Cheerleader
effect_text: Choose Cheered, Excited, or Motivated. All allies affected by the triggering effect gain the chosen condition. This Feature costs 0 AP if the triggering effect affects only one ally, and costs 1 AP if it affects two or more.

name: Gleeful Interference
effect_text: The triggering foe gains a -2 penalty to Accuracy for one full Round.

name: Go, Fight, Win!
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Moment of Action, Expert Charm
effect_text: Choose and perform one of the cheers below. You may perform each Cheer only once per Scene.

name: Inspirational Support
effect_text: You may trigger Cheerleader as a Free Action when your Pokémon with Friend Guard activate an Ability or Status Move that affects only allies.

name: Keep Fighting!
effect_text: That Ally's Hit Point count is reduced to 1 instead, and then gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank doubled.

name: Moment of Action
effect_text: Each target gains 1 Temporary Action Point. These Action Points disappear after one full Round.

name: Accentuated Taste
effect_text: Whenever you create a Snack with a Chef Feature, you may assign it a Taste chosen from Salty, Sour, Spicy, Dry, and Sweet. Tasty Snacks must be assigned their corresponding Taste. Whenever a Pokémon trades in a Digestion Buff from a Snack with an assigned Taste they do not dislike, they gain the following bonuses:

name: Bait Mixer
effect_text: You may create Bait. For $50 more, you may create Bait as Super Bait or Vile Bait instead. Super Bait works like regular Bait, but you may add your Intuition Rank to 1d20 Rolls made to attract Pokémon. Vile Bait works like regular Bait, but Pokémon that eat it are Poisoned.

name: Chef
effect_text: You may use any Chef Recipe for which you qualify.

name: Complex Aftertaste
effect_text: The target gains a Digestion Buff according to the Taste of the Snack granting the Buff. This Digestion Buff matches that of the corresponding basic Tasty Snack recipe.

name: Culinary Appreciation
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the Gluttony Ability.

name: Dietician
effect_text: Your Pokemon can benefit from a maximum of 7 Vitamins.

name: Dumplings
activation_text: At-Will - Extended Action Ingredient 1: Leftovers, Preserves, or a Snack made with Chef Ingredient 2: Leftovers or Preserves
effect_text: You mix the two ingredients into one Snack that has the same effect as its ingredients. The two ingredients must be different items.

name: Hearty Meal
effect_text: You create up to five Hearty Meals, which may be consumed by Trainers as an Extended Action. When consumed, that Trainer gains +2 to their Max AP until the end of their next extended rest. A Trainer may only be under the effect of one Hearty Meal at a time. Hearty Meals not consumed within 20 minutes of being created lose all flavor and all effect.

name: Hits the Spot
effect_text: The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Intuition Rank doubled. These Temporary Hit Points stack from any Temporary Hit Points granted by Accentuated Taste, the Digestion Buff or by the Lunchbox Ability.

name: Leftovers
effect_text: You create Leftovers.

name: Meal Planner
effect_text: You may create the following items, based on your Intuition Rank

name: Preserves
effect_text: The user creates x2 Units of Preserves from the Berry, Herb, or Mushroom. Preserves have the same effect as the consumable from which they were made.

name: Tasty Snacks
effect_text: You create a Salty Surprise, Spicy Wrap, Sour Candy, Dry Wafer, Bitter Treat, or Sweet Confection.

name: Vitamins
effect_text: You create an HP Up, Protein, Iron, Calcium, Zinc, or Carbos for $2450, or Stat Suppressants for

name: Archival Training
effect_text: Each Rank, you gain an Archive.

name: Archive Tutor
effect_text: Select a Record in your Technique Archive that is of a Move that the target can learn by Level Up, TM or by Move Tutor. The target learns the Move and loses 2 Tutor Points. You can target someone else's Pokémon only once with Archive Tutor; you may target your own Pokémon any number of times with Archive Tutor, but they must still abide by any Move Pool Limitations (ie: no more than 3 of the user's Move Pool can come from TMs or Tutor Moves).

name: Chronicler
effect_text: You make Record of the target. Records can be placed in an Archive as an Extended Action. When you take Chronicler, you gain one Archive.

name: Cinematic Analysis
effect_text: You analyze a Record in one of your Archives. Cinematic Analysis's effect depends on the Archive the Record is in. Each of these effects may only be used once per Scene.

name: Observation Party
effect_text: While they are in a Location in your Travel Archive, your Pokémon have the Ability you chose when gaining Travel Archive and gain a +2 bonus to Perception Checks to notice the environment.

name: Targeted Profiling
effect_text: On the target's next turn, they act as if they had the Mold Breaker Ability against all Pokémon and Trainers in your Profile Archive and gains a +2 bonus to Accuracy Rolls against these targets.

name: Battle Conductor
effect_text: You may target up to two additional Allies with the [Orders].

name: Commander
effect_text: Choose one of Ravager Orders, Marksman Orders, Trickster Orders, Guardian Orders, or Precision Orders. You gain the chosen Feature, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

name: Complex Orders
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mastermind, at least two Features with
activation_text: the [Orders] Tag that have targets At-Will - Shift Action
effect_text: You may choose a different Order to give to each Target. You must pay all AP costs and follow Frequency restrictions for all Orders used in this way.

name: Leadership
effect_text: You may use [Orders] that have targets to target any Ally, even if normally those [Orders] would only let you apply the effect to your own Pokemon. Any other conditions still apply.

name: Mobilize
effect_text: The target cannot provoke Attacks of Opportunity on their next turn. Mobilize may target an Ally only once per encounter.

name: Scheme Twist
effect_text: You may target up to two additional Allies with the [Orders].

name: Tip the Scales
effect_text: Your [Orders] with an At-Will Frequency instead target all allies within 10 Meters.

name: Adaptable Performance
effect_text: Choose two of your Pokémon's Moves. Your Pokémon may perform your Contest Move as if had the Contest Typing of one of your chosen Moves, and had the effects of the other. You may not use either move on the next round of the contest. This effect may be used once per Contest.

name: Coordinator
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Grace, Novice Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition
effect_text: Your Pokémon may reroll a single Appeal Roll or Damage Roll. This Ability may be used only once per Contest, and once per Pokémon per Scene.

name: Decisive Director
effect_text: Add or subtract X from the target's Initiative until the end of your next turn. X is equal to your Charm Rank doubled.

name: Flexible Preparations
activation_text: Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition Daily - Extended Action
effect_text: The target may reallocate up to 2d6 of Poffin- Derived Contest Stats from one Contest Stat to another. This effect lasts until the end of the day.

name: Innovation
effect_text: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and then learns a Move created with Innovation. See the next section for details on creating Moves for this Feature. A Pokémon may only have one Move created by Innovation at a time.

name: Nuanced Performance
activation_text: Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition 1 AP - Free Action
effect_text: That Move's Frequency is not expended. This does not work with Moves that may fail to activate, such as moves with the Execute keyword.

name: Reliable Performance
activation_text: Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition 2 AP - Free Action
effect_text: For appeal rolls, instead of making the Appeal Roll, you gain 1 Appeal Point for each Dice you would have rolled. For Accuracy Checks, act as if you had rolled a 10. For Skill Checks, multiply 3.5 by your Pokémon's Skill Rank, and use the resulting number as the result of your roll, rounded down. For all rolls, add or subtract any modifiers as normal.

name: Choreographer
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Dance Form; Adept Acrobatics, Athletics,
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Point and learns a Dance Move created by yourself. Choreographer may target a Pokémon multiple times.

name: Dance Form
effect_text: Create and learn two Dance Moves, plus one more for each other Dancer Feature you have. Whenever you gain another Dancer Feature, create and learn another Dance Move. Beguiling Dance [+Speed] Static When creating Dance Moves, you can choose to create a Dance Move that has Range: 4, 1 Target, AC 3, and lowers a Combat Stat (chosen at creation) by -2 Combat Stages. This Move is otherwise the same as other Dance Moves you could create except that Dance Moves created with this template have the Contest Effect Excitement instead of Get Ready!.

name: Dance Practice
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and gains your choice of Spinning Dance or Own Tempo. Dance Practice may target a Pokémon only once.

name: Dancer
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Novice Acrobatics; Novice Athletics or Charm
effect_text: Choose Spinning Dance or Own Tempo. You gain the chosen Ability.

name: Passing Waltz
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Dance Practice; Master Acrobatics, Ath-
activation_text: letics, or Charm 1 AP - Free Action
effect_text: Choose an ally within 3 meters of the triggering target. That ally gains Combat Stages from the triggering Move instead of the user.

name: Power Pirouette
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Dance Form; Expert Acrobatics, Athlet-
activation_text: ics, or Charm Scene x2 - Swift Action
effect_text: Choose one effect:

name: Directed Focus
effect_text: Whenever your Pokémon with the Exploit or Tolerance Ability are targeted by an [Order], deal Super- Effective Damage, or take Super-Effective Damage, they gain +1 Momentum after all effects of the Move or Order are resolved.

name: Duelist
effect_text: The Foe becomes Tagged; or if the foe is already Tagged, the foe loses the Tag. Only one foe can be Tagged this way at a time. If a new Foe is Tagged, all other Tags are lost.

name: Duelist's Manual
effect_text: Apply one of the following effects. To choose an effect, your Pokémon must have a certain amount of Momentum. (Duelist's Manual does not spend Momentum).

name: Effective Methods
effect_text: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains your choice of the Exploit or Tolerance Ability. You may only target a Pokémon once with Effective Methods.

name: Expend Momentum
effect_text: Apply one of the following effects on the target by spending that much Momentum.

name: Seize The Moment
effect_text: Your Pokémon loses 6 Momentum, and then gains +1 Momentum. Your Pokémon may immediately make an attack as an Interrupt, but this attack must target only a Tagged Foe. If the attack misses, it still deals damage as if it had the Smite keyword. If the attack hits, it's automatically a Critical Hit. If it would have already been a Critical Hit, your Pokémon gains Hit Points equal to half of its maximum Hit Points. May be used only once per Scene per Pokémon .

name: Type Methodology
effect_text: Effects depend on whether your Pokémon has the Tolerance or Exploit ability.

name: Awareness
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Enduring Soul, 3 Pokémon with a
effect_text: Your Pokémon add +2 to all Save Checks.

name: Enduring Soul
effect_text: You may add to your Pokémon's HP stat when they level up, ignoring Base Relation, and you do not need to "correct" Stats due to this inflated HP.

name: Not Yet!
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Enduring Soul, Expert Athletics or Focus
effect_text: Before fainting, the targeted Pokémon gains an Injury, and may then use a Move as an Interrupt. When the Move is resolved, the Pokémon then immediately faints. This consumes a Pokémon turn as normal. This cannot be used with the Moves Explosion, Pain Split, or Self-Destruct.

name: Resilience
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Awareness, Expert Athletics or Focus
effect_text: Your Pokémon does not gain a Status Affliction, and the triggering attack does damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Resilience may only be used once per target per Scene.

name: Shrug Off
effect_text: Once per day, each of your Pokémon may spend a Shift Action to remove 1 Injury from themselves; this may also be activated as a Free Action whenever your Pokémon Take a Breather.

name: Staying Power
effect_text: Your Pokémon may "Take a Breather" even if it is Confused or Enraged, and it does not Trip or have to Shift away from enemies as part of the action. You may choose whether or not your Pokémon resets their Combat Stages to default.

name: Vim and Vigor
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Shrug Off, Master Athletics or Focus
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and gains the Vigor Ability.

name: Accessorize
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Dashing Makeover, one Fashionista Skill
effect_text: You may wear and benefit from two Accessory Slot Items at once. The two items must be of different types and must not share an effect. For example, a Fire Brace cannot be paired with another Fire Brace or a Fire Plate, but it could be paired with an Ice Brace, a Fire Booster, or a Stat Booster.

name: Basic Fashion
effect_text: You create one of the Basic Fashion Items below for which you have the chosen Fashionista Skill. These are Accessory Slot Items and may be used as Held Items by Pokémon.

name: Contest Trends
effect_text: You can create Contest Accessories for $750, Contest Fashion Items for $500, and Fancy Clothes for

name: Dashing Makeover
effect_text: When you activate Dashing Makeover, choose one Equipment or Held Item you can create. While this Feature is Bound, the target gains the effects of the chosen item, as long as they would normally be able to equip it (ex: Trainers cannot equip Incense Items).They do not need to take up an Equipment or Held Item slot to gain this benefit. A target may only be affected by one instance of Dashing Makeover at a time.

name: Dress to Impress
activation_text: Skills at Expert Scene x2 - Standard Action
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains the effect of all items in extra slots granted by Versatile Wardrobe for one full round. Dress to Impress may only target a Pokémon once per Scene.

name: Fashionista
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Two of Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition at Novice
effect_text: You may craft any Fashionista Recipe for which you qualify.

name: Focused Fashion
effect_text: You can create Focus Bands and Focus Sashes for $2000.

name: Incense Maker
effect_text: You can create Lax Incense for $1000, Luck Incense for $900, and Full Incense for $450.

name: Parfumier
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Fashionista, one Fashionista Skill at
effect_text: Whenever you create an Incense Held Item, choose Sweet Scent or Aromatic Mist. While your Pokémon is holding that Incense Item in an active Held Item slot, they add the chosen Move to their Move List.

name: Practical Fashion
effect_text: You can create Go-Goggles, Safety Goggles, or Winter Cloaks for $750.

name: Style is Eternal
effect_text: Your Pokémon instead retains their Held Item. Style is Eternal may only be used once per Scene per Pokémon.

name: Versatile Wardrobe
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Fashionista, two Fashionista Skills at
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and then becomes chic. Chic Pokémon gain two extra Held Item slots with which they can carry Held Items. However, the items in these slots have no effect and are not treated as equipped. As a Swift Action on their turn, Chic Pokémon may swap a currently active Held Item with an item stored in these slots. Chic Pokémon may not carry multiple items of the same type or with repeated effects.

name: Diffuse Pain
effect_text: Choose an additional target for the Move.

name: Grand Hex
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hex Maniac Studies Rank 3, Master
effect_text: Regain one use of a Move gained from Hex Maniac Studies that can inflict a Status Affliction that the triggering target has. If you activated the conditional damage boost for Hex, its Frequency is not expended. You may only activate Grand Hex once per target per Scene.

name: Hex Maniac
effect_text: Choose Cursed Body or Omen. You gain the Chosen Ability.

name: Hex Maniac Studies
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Hex Maniac | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Hex Maniac | Rank 3 Prerequisites: Hex Maniac, Expert Occult
effect_text: Learn two Hex Maniac Moves. You may choose any Move marked with the Hex Maniac Studies Rank you are taking or lower.

name: Malediction
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hex Maniac Studies Rank 1, Expert
activation_text: Occult Education Scene x2 - Free Action
effect_text: Use a Status-Class Move gained from Hex Maniac Studies targeting the triggering foe as a Free Action, Frequency-permitting.

name: Dabbler
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hobbyist, Expert General Education or
effect_text: At the Level 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 Character Advancement Level Milestones, if you choose to gain Bonus Stats, you also gain an Edge for which you qualify. If you choose Bonus Edges or Features, you also gain +2 to your choice of Attack or Special Attack. This applies retroactively.

name: Dilettante
effect_text: Each Rank of Dilettante, you gain both an Edge and a General Feature from the lists below. You may gain the chosen Edge and Feature even if you do not meet the Skill prerequisites. You must meet any other Prerequisites.

name: Hobbyist
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Novice General Education, Novice Perception
effect_text: You gain three Skill Edges for which you qualify.

name: Look and Learn
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hobbyist, Expert General Education or
effect_text: When you activate Look and Learn, you may gain any of the Features below even though they are Features from other Classes. You do not need to meet their normal prerequisites, but you must meet their Prerequisites listed here. Look and Learn can be used two times; once to learn a Feature from the "Scene Features" List, and once to learn a Feature from the "Action Point Features List".

name: Don't Look Away
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Pack Tactics, Adept Stealth, Adept
effect_text: The hit foe loses a Tick of Hit Points, and is Slowed for 1 round. Don't Look Away may be triggered once per round.

name: Finisher
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hunter, Adept Stealth, Adept Survival
effect_text: You and your Pokémon gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls against Fainted, Flinched, Sleeping, Stuck, Slowed, Trapped, or Tripped targets.

name: Hunter
effect_text: Choose Teamwork or Pack Hunt. You gain the Chosen Ability.

name: Hunter's Reflexes
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hunter, Adept Stealth or Survival
effect_text: You and your Pokémon may make up to three Attacks of Opportunity each round, instead of only one. Additionally, your attacks always consider you to be adjacent to your target for the purposes of benefiting from your Pokémon's Teamwork Ability, and count as Melee attacks for the purposes of triggering their Pack Hunt Ability.

name: Pack Master
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Pack Tactics, Expert Stealth, Expert
effect_text: For you and your Pokémon with Teamwork, Teamwork's effect now reads "While you are adjacent to an opponent, allies targeting that opponent receive a +2 bonus to Accuracy Checks". Whenever you or your Pokémon successfully hit a foe with Pack Hunt, they gain a +2 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls and a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls against that foe until the end of their next turn.

name: Pack Tactics
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and gains the Pack Hunt or Teamwork Ability. You may target a Pokémon with Pack Tactics only once.

name: Surprise!
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Hunter, Adept Stealth or Survival
effect_text: Make two attack rolls for the triggering action, and use the better result to finalize the attack. If both attacks would hit, the target is Flinched. Surprise! may be used only once per Scene per target. If the triggering attack was a Poké Ball, Hand Net, Weighted Net, Glue Cannon, or Struggle Attack, Surprise! costs 1 AP to activate; otherwise, it costs 2 AP.

name: Bounce Shot
effect_text: After hitting its mark or landing, your Poké Ball bounces 3 meters in any direction. You may have your Poké Ball trigger captures or releases before or after the bounce.

name: Emergency Release
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Juggler, Expert Acrobatics or Guile
effect_text: You may Release a Pokémon as an Interrupt.

name: First Blood
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Tag In, Master Acrobatics or Guile
effect_text: If you have a Pokémon turn available this round or next, your Pokémon may use a Move as an Interrupt as soon as it is sent out. This consumes your Pokémon turn for the round (or the following round) as normal.

name: Juggler
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Quick Switch, Novice Acrobatics, Novice Guile
effect_text: Using Quick Switch costs only 1 AP. Whenever you send a Pokémon into an encounter from a Poké Ball, they receive a +10 bonus to their Initiative during that round.

name: Juggling Show
effect_text: You may roll an additional Xd6 during the In- troduction Stage of a Contest, where X is half of your Acrobatics Rank. You may choose any Contest Stat to attempt to gain Dice for with this roll.

name: Round Trip
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Juggler, Adept Acrobatics or Guile
effect_text: You may immediately switch your Pokémon that just performed a Move for another of your Pokémon. This effect lets Pokémon with the Trapped condition switch out.

name: Tag In
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Round Trip, Expert Acrobatics or Guile
effect_text: The next Pokémon you send out is treated as if the recalled Pokémon had used Baton Pass on it.

name: Bend Like the Willow
effect_text: You may attempt the same Combat Maneuver against the triggering foe as a Free Action.

name: Heightened Intensity
effect_text: You may use Focus Energy as a Free Action

name: Martial Achievement
effect_text: You gain a Martial Achievement based on your Chosen Ability.

name: Martial Artist
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Basic Martial Arts, Novice Combat
effect_text: Choose one of the abilities listed below. You gain the chosen Ability, and its associated tags. Whenever you gain any Martial Artist Feature, you also gain the associated tags.

name: Martial Training
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Martial Artist | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Martial Artist, Expert Combat | Rank 3 Prerequisites: Martial Artist, Master Combat
effect_text: Learn two Martial Artist Moves. You may choose any Move marked with the Martial Training Rank you are taking or lower. You must meet a Move's Prerequisites to choose that Move.

name: My Kung-Fu is Stronger
effect_text: You may use Rock Smash instead of an unarmed Struggle Attack. If you do, Rock Smash's Effect Range is increased by +2.

name: Pummeling Momentum
effect_text: You Tag the triggering foe and gain a +1 bonus to your Accuracy Rolls and Evasion against that foe. Each subsequent time that you hit the Tagged foe with a Move affected by Iron Fist, this bonus increases by +1, to a maximum of your Combat Rank. If you ever spend a turn without successfully hitting your Tagged foe, the foe loses their Tag and the bonus is lost.

name: Second Strike
effect_text: You may immediately use Rock Smash or a Struggle Attack against your target as a Free Action.

name: Soft Landing
effect_text: When taking fall damage, calculate the result as if you had fallen X meters less, where X is half your Combat Rank. If you miss with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick, you lose no Hit Points as a result.

name: Whirlwind Strikes
effect_text: You may use Rock Smash, targeting against any number of adjacent foes. You do not count as Flanked for one full round.

name: Wrestlemania
effect_text: This turn, you may perform two different Grappling Effects as a Full Action instead of just one.

name: Changing Viewpoints
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mentor, Intuition as a Mentor Skill
effect_text: The target loses a Tutor Point, and you may change the target's Nature to any other Nature which either raises the same Stat as its current nature, or lowers the same Stat as its current Nature.

name: Corrective Learning
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mentor, Intimidate as a Mentor Skill
effect_text: The target loses one effect gained from a Poké Edge or Feature and refunds all Tutor Points spent on it.

name: Egg Tutor
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and learns any Move from its Egg Move List. A Pokémon may be targeted by Egg Tutor only one time.

name: Empowered Development
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mentor, Charm as a Mentor Skill
effect_text: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and gains any three of the following Poké Edges: Skill Improvement, Advanced Mobility, or Capability Training. A Pokémon may be targeted only once by Empowered Development. The target may gain Poké Edges this way even if they do not meet the prerequisites, however, they must still follow other limitations; Advanced Mobility can only improve a Movement Capability once, for example.

name: Expand Horizons
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains 3 Tutor Points. A Pokémon may be targeted by Expand Horizons only once.

name: Guidance
effect_text: Your Pokémon's base Move List Limit is increased by +1 (Reminder: The default Move List Limit is 6).

name: Lessons
effect_text: You may perform any Mentor Lesson for which you qualify.

name: Lifelong Learning
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Move Tutor, one Mentor Skill at Master
effect_text: Your Pokémon may have up to 4 Moves from their Move List come from TMs or Move Tutors.

name: Mentor
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Two of Charm, Intimidate, Intuition, or Pokémon Education at Novice Rank
effect_text: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and then learns a move from its tutor list marked with a (N), or any move on its level-up list learned at X Level or lower, where X is the target's current Level plus the sum of your Mentor Skill Ranks. Note that despite being Tutored, these Moves count as if they were "natural" for organizational purposes.

name: Move Tutor
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mentor, one Mentor Skill at Expert Rank
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and learns any move from its Tutor List.

name: Versatile Teachings
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mentor, Pokémon Education as a Mentor
effect_text: The target loses 1 Tutor Point and may exchange one of its Basic Abilities for any other of its species' Basic Abilities or one of its Advanced Abilities for any of its species' Basic or Advanced Abilities. Note: You may NOT activate Versatile Teachings to reroll Abilities that require a roll to determine characteristics, such as Serpent's Mark and Color Theory.

name: Cacophony
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mt. Moon Blues, Adept Charm or Focus
effect_text: You learn the Moves Screech and Metal Sound.

name: Mt. Moon Blues
effect_text: You learn the Moves Sing and Supersonic

name: Musical Ability
effect_text: Choose Drown Out or Soundproof. You gain the chosen Ability.

name: Musician
effect_text: You may use Musician Songs.

name: Noise Complaint
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Cacophony, Expert Charm or Focus
effect_text: You learn the Moves Uproar and Hyper Voice.

name: Power Chord
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Noise Complaint, Master Charm or
effect_text: Make a Charm or Focus Check, and add your Special Attack. Foes in the area of effect take Special Normal-Type Damage equal to the result.

name: Voice Lessons
effect_text: You and your Pokémon's Moves with the Sonic keyword gain the Friendly keyword. Voice Lessons may not affect the Move Perish Song. Additionally, whenever your Pokémon use a Move with the Sonic Keyword in a Contest, they may roll +1d6.

name: Genjutsu
effect_text: You form an Illusion around yourself. This Illusion may be used to hide yourself in a shroud of darkness if in darkness, or to make yourself look like a mundane object (such as a crate, potted plant, or similar). The Illusion can even fool Aura, concealing you from Aura Sight for its duration. However, the Illusion requires complete concentration, and is broken if you take any actions at all. Anyone that interacts with the Illusion directly may make an Occult Education or Intuition Check with a DC equal to 10 plus your Stealth Rank; if they succeed, the Illusion is broken.

name: Ninja
effect_text: You learn the Moves Double Team and Poison Powder.

name: Ninja's Arsenal
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Ninja | Prerequisites: Ninja, Adept Stealth
effect_text: You may craft an Antidote, Smoke Ball, Caltrops, or Toxic Caltrops for $100. Poison Weapons [+Speed] [Weapon] 1 AP - Free Action The attack or Move Poisons its targets on 16+, and you may have it deal Poison-Type Damage if you wish.

name: Utility Drop
effect_text: You may use a Smoke Ball, Caltrops, or Toxic Caltrops as a Free action during your Shift. Instead of the Move's usual area of effect, you leave one square of Smokescreen, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes on each square you leave as you Shift. Once you place 8 meters of Smoke, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes you may not place any more.

name: Weightless Step
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Ninja, Expert Stealth | Prerequisites: Poison Weapons, Master Stealth
effect_text: You gain the Infiltrator Ability. Kinjutsu [+Speed] Static You learn the Moves Substitute and Toxic.

name: Divination
effect_text: You may perform an Augury or Scrying.

name: Mark of Vision
effect_text: You mark the target with a mystical power which allows you to close your eyes and focus to perceive the world with their senses from their perspective. You may Bind this Ability multiple times, each time on a different target, but you may only concentrate on one Mark of Vision at a time, and you may only have a number of Marks at one time equal to half your Perception Rank. A target may choose to end this effect at any time, or to deny you access to their senses temporarily without ending the effect entirely. You have a rough sense of how far away and in what direction marked targets are.

name: Oracle
effect_text: You gain the Pickup Ability.

name: Prescience
effect_text: The attack instead misses.

name: Small Prophecies
effect_text: Roll 1d20 and note the result. Until the end of your next turn, you may choose to replace a single d20 roll you or a willing ally makes with the noted result.

name: Two-Second Preview
effect_text: You gain the Instinct Ability.

name: Unveiled Sight
effect_text: You can see through Illusions. This means you can spot Illusions from the Illusionist capability, Illusion Ability, and Genjutsu Feature as being fake. You are immune to Moves with the Illusion keyword, Double Team cannot be activated against you, and you bypass Substitutes. As a Standard Action, you can create a Burst 4, dispelling all Illusion effects within.

name: Enchanting Gaze
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Quick Wit, two Provocateur Skills at
effect_text: Choose a Manipulate Maneuver effect; apply that Effect to all foes in a Cone 2. This ignores Frequency Limitations with that Maneuver and automatically succeeds against all targets without an opposed roll.

name: Mixed Messages
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Provocateur, two Provocateur Skills at
effect_text: You learn the Moves Lovely Kiss and Torment.

name: Play Them Like a Fiddle
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Powerful Motivator, a Provocateur Skill
activation_text: at Expert Rank. Scene x3 - Swift Action
effect_text: The Move gains additional effects as listed below. You may use the effects of each Move only once per Scene.

name: Powerful Motivator
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Provocateur, two Provocateur Skills at
effect_text: Baby-Doll Eyes, Confide, Leer, and your Provocateur Moves gain additional effects. These effects occur whether the Move hits or misses.

name: Provocateur
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: One of Confidence Artist, Intimidating Presence, or Charmer
effect_text: You learn the Moves Sweet Kiss and Taunt.

name: Push Buttons
effect_text: Your Social Moves' Frequency is not Expended if they miss. You gain the Demoralize Edge, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. Its effects for Status Moves now trigger on 18+, and Social Moves that activate this "Crit" Range cause their targets to lose a tick of Hit Points. If you already have Demoralize, you may gain another Edge for which you meet the prerequisites.

name: Quick Wit
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Provocateur, a Provocateur Skill at Adept
effect_text: You may make a Manipulate Maneuver or use a Social Move you know, Frequency allowing.

name: Ancient Heritage
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and learns Ancient Power. If the target has Ancient Power in its Level-Up List, Ancient Heritage costs no Tutor Points. As a static effect, whenever your Pokémon use Ancient Power, its activated effect occurs on 18+ and you may always choose whether it deals Physical or Special Damage, using the appropriate attack Stat.

name: Breadth of Knowledge
effect_text: You gain three Skill Edges for which you qualify. These Edges must be used to gain a Skill Edge with an Education Skill, or to gain an Edge that has an Education Skill as a Prerequisite that you meet.

name: Caustic Chemistry
effect_text: Make a Technology Education Roll. All targets affected by this Feature's trigger lose Hit Points equal to your roll. This may only affect a target once per Scene.

name: Chakra Crystal
effect_text: You create a Stat Booster.

name: Chemical Warfare
effect_text: The Pester Ball creates a Blast 2, affecting all targets in the area.

name: Chemist
effect_text: You may craft any Chemistry Recipe for which you qualify using your Chemistry Set.

name: Climate Control
effect_text: The triggering Weather Effect does not replace the already extant Weather in effect; both exist simultaneously on the field. If a new Weather effect is placed on the field after the two that are out, both are replaced by the third, unless you activate this Feature again to replace only one.

name: Climatology
effect_text: You gain the Overcoat Ability.

name: Crystal Resonance
effect_text: You roll an additional 3d6 when determining how many Shards you find when Dowsing.

name: Echoes of the Future
effect_text: You may roll twice and keep the best result.

name: Enhancers
effect_text: You can create any X-Item, Dire Hit, or Guard Spec.

name: Extreme Weather
effect_text: The Weather is particularly intense and has additional effects.

name: Fistful of Force

effect_text: You may destroy the Shard to use the Move Judgment. Judgment's Type must be one of the Types associated with the used Shard. Instead of adding your Special Attack when using this attack, you may choose to add your Occult Education Rank tripled.

name: Focus Gem
effect_text: You create a Focus that may crafted to be worn as your choice of an Accessory Item, Head Slot Item, or Hand or Off-Hand Item.

effect_text: The resulting Pokémon is born with 2 fewer Tutor Points, and gains its second Basic Ability. If it has only has one Basic Ability, it gains one of its Advanced Abilities, chosen by the GM. This Feature does not affect how the Pokémon continues to gain Abilities.

effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and learns any Move from its Egg Move or Tutor Move List. Genetic Memory may target a Pokémon only twice: once with a Tutor Move and once with an Egg Move. Egg Moves tutored this way do not count against the limit of 3 for TM and Tutor Moves.

name: Herb Lore
effect_text: You may create Energy Powder, Heal Powder, or Poultices from ingredients, as listed below.

name: Hyper Cures
effect_text: You can create Full Heals for $300, Hyper Potions for $400, and Full Restores for $700.

name: Immutable Mind
effect_text: If the triggering Move was a Status-Class Move, the Move fails. If the Triggering Move was a Damaging Move with a Secondary Effect that triggers on a certain roll, you are immune to the secondary effect.

name: Instant Analysis
effect_text: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the Forewarn Ability.

name: Live and Learn
effect_text: Add half of your General Education Rank to the next roll of the same type that the triggering user makes.

name: Medical Techniques
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Patch Cure, Expert Medicine Education
effect_text: The target gains a Tick of Hit Points, plus an additional amount of Hit Points equal to your Medicine Education Rank.

name: Medicinal Blend
effect_text: You fuse the two Ingredients, creating an Item that has the properties of both. If you choose two Restoratives, they cannot be Restoratives with the same effect (you could not for example, mix a Potion and a Super Potion). If a Restorative Patch is used as an Ingredient, the resulting item can only be used as an Extended Action.

name: Mental Resistance
effect_text: You gain the Mindlock Capability and 10 Damage Reduction against Special Psychic, Ghost, and Dark-Type damage.

name: Patch Cure
effect_text: You distill the target, gaining 3 Restorative Patches. Restorative Patches have the same effect as the items from which they were created, but can only be applied as an Extended Action.

name: Performance Enhancers
effect_text: You create a PP Up or Heart Booster. If you have a Heart Scale, you may destroy the Heart Scale to create a Heart Booster without paying the monetary cost.

name: Pester Balls: Disorient
effect_text: You create Pester Balls that can inflict Rage or Confusion.

name: Pester Balls: Pain
effect_text: You create Pester Balls that can inflict Burn or Poison.

name: Pester Balls: Shut Down
effect_text: You create Pester Balls that can inflict Paralysis or Sleep.

name: Playing God
effect_text: Choose Castform, Grimer, Koffing, Magnemite, Porygon, Solosis, Trubbish, or Voltorb. Using your chemistry set, you create an artificial Egg of the Chosen Pokémon, that hatches within a day. The resulting Pokemon is born at level 5, with the Nature and Ability of your choice (Abilities chosen from its species' Basic Abilities). Additionally, you may enhance the Pokemon in several ways. Choose a number of upgrades below equal to your Technology Education Rank.

name: Prehistoric Bond
effect_text: You also produce a Held Item from the remnants of the Fossil. The effect of this Held Item is based on the highest Base Stat of the individual Pokémon being Revived, counting the effects of Nature but no other effects that alter Base Stats. If there is a tie, the GM decides which Base Stat is used. This Held Item may only be used by Pokémon revived from Fossils.

name: Psionic Analysis
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Witch Hunter, Master Occult Education
effect_text: You are able to analyze Psychic Residue and can determine the following information about the Trainer or Pokémon that left the residue:

name: Pusher
effect_text: Your Pokémon gain the Basic Ranged Attacks, Aura Pulse, Enticing Bait, Extended Invisibility, Far Reading, Precise Threadings, Seismometer, TK Mastery, and Trail Sniffer Poke Edges automatically if they qualify for them, without having to invest any Tutor Points.

name: Rainbow Gem
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Rainbow Light, Expert Occult Education
effect_text: You create a Rainbow Gem that may crafted to be worn as your choice of an Accessory Item, Head Slot Item, or Hand or Off-Hand Item. This item has the same effect as a Focus, except that as an Extended Action, any Trainer with Expert Occult Education Rank or higher may change which Stat the Rainbow Amulet is attuned to.

name: Re-Balancing
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and gains one of the following: +1 to all Base Stats, +2 to two different Base Stats, or +3 to a single Base Stat. The target then redistributes their Stat Points. A Pokémon may be targeted by Re-Balancing only once.

name: Researcher
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: An Education Skill at Novice Rank
effect_text: Choose two Researcher Fields of Study. You may take Features from those Fields with this instance of Researcher. Gain one Feature from a chosen Researcher Field for which you qualify.

name: Restorative Science
effect_text: You create an Antidote, Paralyze Heal, Awakening, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, or Potion.

name: Seed Bag

name: Skill Trainer
effect_text: For each of your Pokémon that has been Trained during this time, choose a Skill; that Skill becomes Pushed until an Extended Rest is taken. Pokémon rolls +1d6 with Pushed Skills, unless that would cause you to roll more than 6d6; if so, that Pokémon rolls with a +3 Bonus instead. A Pokémon may have only one Pushed Skill at a time.

name: Super Cures
effect_text: You can create Revives and Super Potions.

name: This One's Special, I Know It
effect_text: The Pokémon is born with special qualities, determined by the GM. This Feature may be activated one time per Pokémon Education Rank above Untrained.

name: Top Tier Berries
effect_text: You may grow additional Berries and Herbs, depending on the higher of your General Education or Survival Rank.

name: Weather Systems
effect_text: Your Pokemon loses 2 Tutor Points, and learns your choice of Hail, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Sunny Day. The target must be able to learn the chosen Move through Level-Up, TM, or Tutor Moves. If the target has the chosen Move in their Level-Up List, Weather Systems costs no Tutor Points.

name: Witch Hunter
effect_text: You gain the "Psionic Sight" Feature, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. If you already had the Psionic Sight Feature, you instead gain another Feature for which you qualify.

name: Cavalier's Reprisal

effect_text: You may make a Struggle Attack against the triggering foe.

effect_text: This round, if being used as a Mount, the target may use Dash, Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line range Moves with a range of Pass instead of their usual range.

name: Lean In
effect_text: Both you and your Mount Resist the attack one step further.

name: Overrun
activation_text: or Athletics Scene x2 - Free Action
effect_text: Your Pokémon adds their Speed Stat in addition to their normal attacking Stat to their Damage Roll. The target gains Damage Reduction against this attack equal to their own Speed Stat.

name: Ramming Speed
effect_text: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the Run Up Ability.

name: Ride as One
effect_text: While you are Mounted, you and your Mount each use the highest of each other's Speed Evasion. If both you and your Mount have the same Speed Evasion, you instead each receive a +1 bonus to Speed Evasion. Whenever one of you receives Initiative, either of you may take your turn. When the next person would receive initiative, the person that did not take their turn then takes it.

name: Rider
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Mounted Prowess, Agility Training, Novice Acrobatics or Athletics
effect_text: While you are Mounted on a Pokemon under the effects of Agility Training, the bonuses from Agility Training are doubled.

name: Cutthroat
effect_text: You may use Rogue Moves as Weapon Moves when wielding Small Melee Weapons or Short Ranged Weapons. If you do, Rogue Moves instead have the same Range as your Weapon. Additionally, you may qualify for Weapon Moves for Small Melee or Short Ranged Weapons and resist Disarm Maneuvers when wielding such Weapons using any Rogue Skill.

name: Dirty Fighting
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Rogue, a Rogue Skill at Adept Rank
effect_text: After the attack is Resolved, you may immediately use the Dirty Trick Maneuver if the target is within range. You automatically hit with Dirty Trick, but must still make an Opposed Roll.

name: Rogue
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Two of Acrobatics, Athletics, and Stealth at Novice Rank
effect_text: You learn the Moves Feint Attack and Thief. Note: Acrobatics, Athletics, and Stealth are referred to as "Rogue Skills" as short-hand.

name: Scoundrel's Strike
effect_text: The target loses Hit Points equal to your highest Rogue Skill Rank doubled, and an additional effect based on whether you have the Ambush or Cruelty Ability. You may use Scoundrel's Strike only once per Scene per target.

name: Street Fighter
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Unexpected Attacks, two Rogue Skills at
effect_text: You learn the Moves Assurance and Payback.

name: Underhanded Tactics
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Rogue, a Rogue Skill at Expert Rank
effect_text: You gain your choice of Ambush or Cruelty.

name: Unexpected Attacks
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Rogue, two Rogue Skills at Adept Rank
effect_text: You learn the Moves Pursuit and Sucker Punch.

name: Cruel Gaze
effect_text: You learn the Moves Glare and Headbutt.

name: Fearsome Display
effect_text: The Move gains additional effects.

name: Malice
effect_text: You learn the Moves Mean Look and Chip Away.

name: Menace
effect_text: Until their next turn, the target has their Initiative lowered to 0. For one full round, attacks against them cause them to Flinch on 17+ or have their existing Flinch Range increased by +4.

name: Mettle
effect_text: Resolve Damage as if the triggering attack was resisted one step. The triggering foe then loses 2 Combat Stages in the Attack Stat used by the triggering Attack.

name: Roughneck
effect_text: The foe loses a Combat Stage in the Stat of your choice.

name: Tough as Nails
effect_text: You learn the Moves Endure and Slack Off.

name: Divine Wind
effect_text: Choose a type of Blessing you can generate with a Sage Move. All Blessings you generated of another type become Blessings of the chosen type. This may not be used to generate more uses of a Blessing than the original Move creates. For example, three Lucky Chant Blessings would become two Reflect or Light Screen Blessings, not three. You may only choose a Blessing type once per Scene.

name: Highly Responsive to Prayers
effect_text: You may use the Sage Feature as a Free Action targeting the triggering ally. Multiple instances of Sage's effect that you use may stack when used this way.

name: Lay on Hands
effect_text: Choose Blessed Touch or Healer. You gain the Chosen Ability.

name: Mystic Defense
effect_text: You learn the Moves Light Screen and Safeguard.

name: Sacred Shield
effect_text: You learn the Moves Reflect and Lucky Chant.

name: Sage
effect_text: The target gains Damage Reduction equal to your Occult Education Rank doubled or their Tick Value, whichever is higher, for one full round.

name: Sage's Benediction
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Sacred Shield or Mystic Defense, Adept
effect_text: The triggering ally gains an additional benefit as follows, depending on the Move used. The benefit takes effect after the Blessing and the attack that triggered it are resolved.

name: Stat Ace
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Ace Trainer or Style Expert, 1 Pokémon with the chosen stat of 15 or more, Novice Command or | Prerequisites: 3 Pokémon with the chosen stat at 20 or higher, Novice Command or Focus
effect_text: Your Pokémon have their Chosen Base Stat increased by +1, and by +1 more for every 10 Levels they have (for example, a Level 20 Pokémon would have your Chosen Stat's base value increased by +3). Additionally, your Pokémon may ignore Base Relations, as long as they are adding to the Stat chosen for Stat Ace, and you do not need to "correct" Stats due to this inflated Stat Value.

name: Stat Embodiment
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: 4 Stat Ace Features, Expert Command or
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains an Ability, based on your Chosen Stat, for the remainder of the Scene. Switching does not end this effect. Stat Embodiment may only grant one Ability to a Pokémon at a time. If it is used a second time on the same target, it replaces the first granted Ability.

name: Stat Link
effect_text: The triggering Pokémon has gains +1 Combat Stage in your Chosen Stat. (Note: The "Default" number of Combat Stages is usually 0)

name: Stat Maneuver
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Stat Ace, Adept Command or Focus
effect_text: Stat Maneuver's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat:

name: Stat Mastery
effect_text: Stat Mastery's Effect depends on your Chosen Stat:

name: Stat Stratagem
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Stat Link, Stat Training, Master Focus or
effect_text: While this Feature is Bound, the target has the following bonuses based on your Chosen Stat:

name: Stat Training
effect_text: Your Pokémon loses 1 Tutor Point, and learns a Move based on your Chosen Stat, even if your Pokémon cannot normally learn this Move:

name: Action Hero Stunt
effect_text: Instead of using a Skill for this Check, your Pokémon rolls their Cool Dice from Poffins and adds their number of Cool Dice from Stats as a modifier. For example, a Pokémon with 5d6 Cool from Poffins and 2d6 from Attack rolls 5d6+2. Skill Checks invoked by Intercepting attacks, Combat Maneuvers, Moves, and Abilities don't trigger this Feature. Example Trigger: Charging into a burning building for a heroic rescue. Cast: To decide whether an action triggers Action Hero Stunt, ask yourself if there are dramatic consequences for the outcome and if the player chose a risky and cool option over safer alternatives.

name: Beautiful Ballet
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Style Expert, Beauty as Chosen | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Expert Intuition
effect_text: Your Pokémon with at least 3d6 in their Beauty Stat from Poffins may activate Beautiful Ballet as a Standard Action to perform one of the following Moves. They must still follow frequency limits as usual for these Moves.

name: Cool Conduct
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Style Expert, Cool as Chosen | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Expert Command
effect_text: Your Pokémon with at least 3d6 in their Cool Stat from Poffins may activate Cool Conduct as a Standard Action to perform one of the following Moves. They must still follow frequency limits as usual for these Moves.

name: Cute Cuddle
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Style Expert, Cute as Chosen | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Expert Charm
effect_text: Your Pokémon with at least 3d6 in their Cute Stat from Poffins may activate Cute Cuddle as a Standard Action to perform one of the following Moves. They must still follow frequency limits as usual for these Moves.

name: Endurance
effect_text: Your Pokémon can ignore up to X meters of falling when calculating falling damage, act without beginning to suffocate for X additional rounds, or ignore the Hit Point loss effects from acting while Heavily Injured for X rounds. X is equal to half its number of Tough Dice from Poffins.

name: Enticing Beauty
effect_text: The target acts as a Bait item as if it had the Alluring Capability. Add its number of Beauty Dice from Poffins as a Bonus to all d20 lure rolls.

name: Learn From Your Mistakes
effect_text: Your Pokémon may re-roll the Skill Check with a Bonus equal to its number of Smart Dice from Poffins.

name: Let's Be Friends!
effect_text: The target may attempt to improve the disposition of a Wild Pokémon as if making a Charm Check. They roll their Cute Dice from Poffins and add their number of Cute Dice from Stats as a modifier. For example, a Pokémon with 4d6 Cute from Poffins and 3d6 Cute from Speed rolls 4d6+3 in place of a Charm Check.

name: Smart Scheme
prerequisites_text: Rank 1 Prerequisites: Style Expert, Smart as Chosen | Rank 2 Prerequisites: Expert Guile
effect_text: Your Pokémon with at least 3d6 in their Smart Stat from Poffins may activate Smart Scheme as a Standard Action to perform one of the following Moves. They must still follow frequency limits as usual for these Moves.

name: Style Entrainment
effect_text: Your Pokémon gains one of the following Abilities corresponding to your chosen Contest Stat for the rest of the Scene, even if it is switched out. Style Entrainment may only grant one Ability to a Pokémon at a time. If it is used a second time on the same target, it replaces the first granted Ability.

name: Style Expert
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: 3 Pokémon with 3d6 in a specific certain Contest Stat from Poffins | Prerequisites: Coordinator, 1 Pokémon with 3d6 in a specific certain Contest Stat from Poffins
